Definition
[Parametrix for $L_{x,\tau }$] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0293 1. ch24:24.10\group Global Parametrix

A smooth function $P$ is a parametrix if $L_{x,\tau }P$ and $L^*_{y,v}P$ extend continuously to $\tau =v$, and $P$ converges to the delta distribution in either time direction.
